name: Sparse Voxel Octree (SVO) LOD Pipeline
definition: A unified pipeline using an in-house sparse-voxel-octree (SVO) geometry cache to support all assets through multiple workflows with consistent and efficient throughput to lighting and rendering, addressing the challenge of populating, animating, and raytracing dynamic shots with thousands of intricate characters.
summary: The Sparse Voxel Octree LOD Pipeline is a unified production method that converts complex assets into a pre-voxelized, LOD-managed cache, separating preparation from rendering to streamline lighting and reduce memory footprint.
